commit_subject: Support numpy2 on windows (#306)
version: 0.6.1

vendored_at: 2026-08-13
clone_command: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/AdaptiveMotorControlLab/CEBRA.git cebra

reason:
  Source is vendored rather than pip-installed because we expect to modify the
  encoder architecture and the deployment path for our no-backprop calibration
  setting. A pip package would make those edits invisible and unreviewable.
  The .git and .github directories were removed so this is a plain vendored tree
  inside the parent repository rather than a nested clone.

local_modifications:
  2026-08-13 Track B (cebra_frozen_source_adapt):
    File: cebra/integrations/sklearn/cebra.py
    Change: CEBRA.fit / partial_fit / _prepare_fit accept freeze_sessions and
            init_from. freeze_sessions sets requires_grad=False on those session
            encoders and builds Adam on the remaining parameters only. init_from
            copies encoder state_dicts from a fitted multi-session estimator
            into the first N sessions of a larger joint fit.
    Why: Multi-session CEBRA shares zero weights (coordinator F2b). Cross-session
         alignment exists only while sessions are in the same contrastive loader.
         Official adapt=True is a single-session objective and cannot land a new
         session in the source latent (coordinator F8, target R2 -1.23 vs joint
         +0.99). freeze_sessions+init_from lets us train only the target encoder
         while keeping cross-session positive sampling — the minimum-cost
         adaptation that still aligns.
    Default behaviour is unchanged: both kwargs default to None.
